text.content:
Mixing Kit

Stained spoons, a little mortar and bottles whose labels only you can read.

Rules

Bulk: 1. Use: Reusable tools for a recipe that names a mixing kit. No inventory die; ingredients and finished mixtures have their own supply dice. An ability that grants a missing kit supplies it on acquisition, not on every use.

ID: item-mixing-kit

Market price: 20 coins. Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
